svg.title: Elixir AI Engineer — the living substrate
svg.desc: Three concentric feedback loops: an inner candidate loop running in seconds, a middle normalization loop running in minutes, and an outer harness evolution loop running across sessions. All loops operate against a central substrate of five graphs.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does harness evolution work? What changes across sessions?')

svg.text: harness evolution loop — updates rules, costs, operators across sessions

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens in the normalization loop? How does code get compressed?')

svg.text: normalization loop — compresses working code toward ENF after each candidate

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the candidate generation loop?')

svg.text: candidate loop — spec → skeleton → bounded LM fill → evidence → accept?

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a SpecCell and what does it contain?')
sendPrompt('What does the deterministic skeleton generator produce?')
sendPrompt('What is a context bundle and how is it different from a prompt?')
sendPrompt('What can the LM do in bounded fill? What is it forbidden from doing?')
g.text: fills holes only · no arch invention
